blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Agusanon obstacle course racer Elias Tabac finished 10th at the 2026 Spartan World Championship in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, cementing his place among the sport’s global elite. The Top 10 finish marks a major leap from his 17th-place showing at the 2022 edition of the prestigious race, reflecting four years of steady progression on the international circuit. Tabac finished the grueling race on Sunday in two hours, 27 minutes and 23 seconds, according to his Facebook post.
